title: SpinBox awkwardly rounds displayed value, specifically showing impossible values when step property is set
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in 4.6 and 4.7 (2af785641a)
- Not tested anywhere else
- Issue #18251 mentions a similar problem on 3.0.2

### System information

Windows 11 & Linux Mint 22.3

### Issue description

This issue is for a pull request I'm planning.

When setting the step of the spin box to something like 0.25 the spin box will round the value for it's display in a misleading manner.
Clicking through the values on the spin box will then do the following:
```
Internal value: 0    Displayed value: 0
Internal value: 0.25 Displayed value: 0.2
Internal value: 0.5  Displayed value: 0.5
Internal value: 0.75 Displayed value: 0.8
Internal value: 1    Displayed value: 1
```

When reading the value property directly the result will be the internal value. Just the display gets rounded awkwardly. This is particularly misleading when you rely on the display to be accurate.

What I'd expect to happen: The displayed values should be 0, 0.25, 0.5, 0.75, 1
When step size is 0.33 the displayed values should be: 0.33, 0.66, 0.99 (Currently 0.3, 0.7, 1)

### Steps to reproduce

(the MRP conveniently has an interface  set up for testing)
- Create empty scene
- Add SpinBox
- Set step to 0.25
- (Optional): Set max_value to 1.0 for easier testing
- (Optional): Connect value_changed signal to print value to console
- Run scene
- Click the arrows, observe how the value is set to 0.25 internally but only displays 0.2 in the spin box

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

[spin-box-display-issue.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/26361264/spin-box-display-issue.zip)
